Corporal punishment shall be administered by paddling the buttocks only , by hand or with a paddle approximately 20 inches long, 4 inches wide and not exceeding ½ inch in thickness, such punishment to consist of not more than 3 swats (either by hand or paddle) on the buttocks area to be inflicted in such manner and with such force as not to cause serious bodily injury to the child.
